name: Australia On Line
summary: Melbourne ISP + e-business software developer (australiaonline.net.au / ozonline.com.au, 'since 1994'; home/corporate connections, hosting); company still registered, later trading as Lizzy Internet / 1300EasyISP (AUSTRALIA ON LINE PTY. LTD., ACN 064 289 925); distinct from aol.com.au's AOL Australia.

events.details: ISP + e-business software; site advertised 'since 1994' (ACN 064 289 925 registered c. 1994).

Australia On Line retail site (australiaonline.net.au) last archived c. 2005; company AUSTRALIA ON LINE PTY. LTD. (ACN 064 289 925, Warrandyte VIC) remains registered, later trading as Lizzy Internet and 1300EasyISP (both from Jun 2016).
